title: Gentle Desktop layout
brief: Replace the app's sidebar layout with one that mirrors the Gentle Shell terminal: petal prompt, work panels, status bar, and no permanent conversation list. For people who never used a terminal but should feel the same tool.

artboards.title: Terminal faithful
artboards.tradeoff: Highest fidelity: fixed 50ch rail, header row, panel prompt and one status bar. The rail costs transcript width below 140 columns.

artboards.title: One column with work rows
artboards.tradeoff: Keeps the terminal's language without a permanent column: tasks, helpers and changes belong to the turn. Less status always visible.
